evidence: The following description covers the walkway from Kaituna Valley to The Hilltop, but other access and exit points are possible.
Te Ara Pātaka/Summit Walkway links Kaituna Valley in the Lyttelton crater to The Hilltop in the Akaroa crater.
The track can be completed as a one-way walk most of the year.
Walkers should head up to Montgomery Park Scenic Reserve and walk directly to The Hilltop.
The track emerges from the reserve onto Summit Road.

doubts: Start: the text says Kaituna Valley; I gave F6, where the Kaituna Valley Packhorse Hut Track (the first section) meets Parkinsons Road, though the road is not named in the text. End: the text says the walk ends at The Hilltop after the track emerges onto Summit Road and crosses it; I gave F5 (an unnamed track at Christchurch Akaroa Road, at the Hilltop place) rather than F4 (Te Ara Pātaka Walkway at Summit Road); F4 could instead be the intended end, and T8 (Hilltop place) is the same place. Rod Donald Hut is reached down a 25 min access track from Waipuna Saddle and then the walk climbs back to the saddle; I listed it in via as the overnight hut. The Diamond Harbour jetty start (2-day public transport trip) is recorded as an access point; the text does not say where its track joins, other than that a track from Te Waipapa/Diamond Harbour joins near the Mt Herbert summit. Gebbies Pass is an alternative route to Packhorse Hut. Pettigrews Road is an entry/exit for mountain bikes only.
